title: Home first aid, danger signs, and earning from your hygiene skills

say: Home first aid, danger signs, and earning from your hygiene skills.
This is the video for module 4 of Home Hygiene and Sanitation.
Many child poisonings happen because a chemical was poured into a soft drink or water bottle, and a child drank it.
So keep every chemical in its original labelled container.
The label tells a health worker what was swallowed.

panel.heading: Store chemicals the safe way
items: High up or locked away from children
Away from food and drinking water
Never mixed, never reused for water

say: Store chemicals high up or in a locked cupboard, out of children's sight and reach.

say: For a burn from hot water or oil, cool it under cool, clean running water for a long time.
Remove rings near the burn, and cover it loosely with a clean cloth.
Never apply oil, palm oil, toothpaste, raw egg or ice.
A burn larger than the person's palm, or on a baby, needs a health facility.

cards.d: Cool under cool, clean running water for a long time. No oil, toothpaste, egg or ice.
Do not make them vomit. Go to the nearest health facility now, with the container.
Rinse with plenty of clean running water, eyelids open. Keep rinsing on the way to care.

say: If a chemical is swallowed, do not make the person vomit, and do not give oil. Go to the nearest health facility immediately with the container.

say: For a chemical in the eye, rinse straight away with plenty of clean running water, holding the eyelids open, and keep rinsing on the way to care.

say: WHO defines diarrhoea as 3 or more loose or liquid stools a day, or more often than normal for that person.
The main danger is dehydration, losing water and salts, which can become serious quickly in a small child.

panel.heading: Diarrhoea: care at home while you watch
items: Diarrhoea: 3 or more loose stools a day
Start ORS, mixed exactly as the sachet says
No medicines without a health worker

say: Start oral rehydration solution, ORS, mixed exactly as the sachet says with safe water.

say: Check for danger signs every few hours.
Blood in the stool.
Diarrhoea for many days.
Signs of dehydration, like sunken eyes, being very sleepy, or little urine.
Large amounts of watery diarrhoea, or several people ill at once, which can be cholera.
Or fever after contact with rats, which needs early testing for Lassa fever.
For example, Fatima in Sokoto logged her daughter's loose stools: 4 on Monday, 3 on Tuesday, with ORS and breastfeeding.
On Wednesday she saw blood, and went to the health centre that morning with her log.

panel.heading: Danger signs: go to a health facility
items: Diarrhoea that goes on for many days
Very thirsty, sunken eyes, little urine
Heavy watery diarrhoea, many people ill

say: Everything in this course is a skill people pay for.
But many new cleaners quote a figure that sounds fair and later find they made nothing.
For example, Blessing in Abuja visits a flat first, and estimates 5 hours for herself and one helper.

say: Her cost-based price is the minimum she can accept.
She adds a profit of 25% on cost, which is 3,000 naira.
She quotes 15,000 naira in writing, listing what is included and what is not.
If she does 8 jobs like this a month, her profit is 24,000 naira, after paying everyone, including herself.
Check your price against the market, and save by grouping jobs. But never skip gloves or dilute products below the label strength. Customers notice.

panel.heading: Blessing's quote
panel.rule: Never cut costs by skipping gloves or diluting products.

say: To remember.
Lock chemicals away in their own containers.
Cool burns with running water.
Never make a poisoned person vomit.
Give ORS and keep feeding, and go at once for any danger sign.
And cost every job, including your own labour, before you add profit.
Make no health claims you cannot support.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Chemicals in original containers, locked away
Cool burns with running water; never oil
Swallowed chemical: no vomiting, go with the label
ORS and feeding; danger signs mean go now
Cost every job, then add your profit
